raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

Add `llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()` for full Llama 3.1 405B pretraining on 64 GB200 GPUs at 8K. The recipe uses TP8/PP8/VPP8/CP1, MXFP8 with FP8 parameter gather and gradient-buffer reuse, BF16 gradients, no recompute, and CUDA graphs off. Tensor-parallel communication overlap remains enabled.

## Changelog

- Export the recipe through the Llama and top-level recipe packages for `run_recipe.py`.
- Retain global batch 1536, microbatch 1, FP32 Adam/master states, training schedule, checkpoint defaults and numerical checks.
- Add finalized-configuration/default-preservation tests and document topology, data setup and measured results.

## Validation

The equivalent configuration completed 10 real WikiText-103 updates in NeMo 26.10.rc10 on 64 GB200 GPUs within one NVLink domain. All 64 ranks exited 0 with finite losses/gradients and no skipped updates. Loss decreased from 15.0329 to 12.8288. Median updates 4–10: 288.85 seconds, approximately 1718 model TFLOP/s/GPU. Maximum allocated/reserved memory across ranks: 154.59/157.14 GiB.

CUDA graphs exceeded memory in the tested TP8 configuration; both tested TP4/PP16 variants also exceeded memory with graphs off. This recipe selects the validated TP8/PP8 no-recompute configuration. These are short capacity/stability results; long-term convergence and MXFP8 checkpoint save/resume are not verified.

All 33 targeted recipe tests passed in RC10. The packaged recipe’s finalized model/precision/parallelism/communication settings match the successful training run; normal checkpoint/data/logging defaults are retained. All-files pre-commit and `git diff --check` pass. Independent diff review completed. Strict mypy on the workstation could not resolve the uninstalled runtime dependencies.

## Pre-checks

- [x] Contributor guidelines followed.
- [x] Necessary tests added.
- [x] Documentation updated.
- [x] No new dependencies or CI workflow changes.

 ### Pre-training Example
 
+#### Llama 3.1 405B on 64 GB200 GPUs
+
+`llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()` configures the full 126-layer
+model at sequence length 8192 with TP8, PP8, VPP8, CP1, and sequence parallelism.
+Place all 16 four-GPU nodes within one NVLink domain. At 64 GPUs, data
+parallelism is one; global batch 1536 and microbatch one accumulate 1536
+microbatches per optimizer update. Keep this global batch fixed when launching.
+
+The recipe uses MXFP8 with FP8 parameter gather and gradient-buffer reuse,
+BF16 gradient accumulation, and FP32 optimizer master parameters and Adam
+moments. Activation recomputation and CUDA graphs are disabled. Tensor-parallel
+communication overlap and the Transformer Engine RNG tracker are enabled.
+There is no optimizer or activation offload. Training schedule, checkpointing,
+and numerical checks retain their base training defaults.
+
+Validation in NeMo 26.10.rc10 on 64 GB200 GPUs completed 10 updates on real
+WikiText-103 tokenized with the native Llama 3.1 tokenizer. All ranks exited
+successfully with finite losses and gradients and no skipped updates. Median
+update time after warmup was 289 seconds, approximately 1718 model TFLOP/s/GPU.
+Peak allocated/reserved GPU memory across all ranks was 154.6/157.1 GiB.
+This validates short-run capacity and stability; long-term convergence and
+MXFP8 checkpoint save/resume were not tested. Enabling CUDA graphs exceeded
+memory in the tested configuration.
+
+The default dataset is synthetic. For real-text training, supply an indexed
+dataset produced with the native Llama 3.1 tokenizer (128256 vocabulary entries):
+
+```python
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.llama import llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config
+from megatron.bridge.training.gpt_step import forward_step
+from megatron.bridge.training.pretrain import pretrain
+
+cfg = llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()
+cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_type = "HuggingFaceTokenizer"
+cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_model = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B"
+cfg.dataset.blend = (["/path/to/llama-tokenized-data"], [1.0])
+cfg.dataset.split = "9998,1,1"
+cfg.checkpoint.save = "/path/to/checkpoints"
+cfg.checkpoint.load = cfg.checkpoint.save
+pretrain(cfg, forward_step)
+```
+
+Launch this script with 64 distributed processes, one per GPU. Dataset prefixes
+refer to the corresponding `.bin` and `.idx` files without their extensions.
+The recipe is also exported as
+`--recipe llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config` for
+`scripts/training/run_recipe.py`.
+
+#### Llama 3 8B
+

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Llama 3.1 training configurations for GB200."""
+
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.llama.h100.llama3 import llama31_405b_pretrain_256gpu_h100_bf16_config
+from megatron.bridge.training.config import ConfigContainer
+from megatron.bridge.training.mixed_precision import bf16_with_mxfp8_mixed
+
+
+def llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config() -> ConfigContainer:
+    """Configure 405B MXFP8 pretraining at 8K on 64 GB200 GPUs.
+
+    Uses TP8/PP8/VPP8/CP1 with sequence parallelism, no activation recomputation,
+    and no CUDA graphs. Tensor-parallel communication overlap is enabled.
+    Place the sixteen four-GPU nodes within one NVLink domain. At 64 GPUs,
+    DP is one: global batch 1536 and microbatch one accumulate 1536 microbatches
+    per optimizer update. Keep the global batch fixed when sizing a launch.
+
+    MXFP8 parameter gather reuses the gradient buffer. Gradient accumulation
+    is BF16; optimizer master parameters and Adam moments remain FP32. No
+    optimizer or activation offload is enabled. The training schedule,
+    checkpointing, and numerical checks retain their training defaults.
+    Configure a tokenizer and indexed dataset for real-text training; the
+    default dataset is synthetic.
+
+    Validated for 10 real-text updates in NeMo 26.10.rc10: approximately 1718
+    model TFLOP/s/GPU, 289 seconds/update, and 154.6 GiB peak allocated memory.
+    This is a capacity/stability check, not a long-term convergence result.
+    MXFP8 checkpoint save/resume was not exercised in this validation.
+    """
+    cfg = llama31_405b_pretrain_256gpu_h100_bf16_config()
+    cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size = 8
+    cfg.model.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 8
+    cfg.model.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size = 8
+    cfg.model.context_parallel_size = 1
+    cfg.model.sequence_parallel = True
+    cfg.model.seq_length = 8192
+    cfg.dataset.seq_length = 8192
+    cfg.model.vocab_size = 128256
+    cfg.model.should_pad_vocab = True
+    cfg.tokenizer.vocab_size = 128256
+    cfg.tokenizer.use_tokenizer_vocab_size = False
+    cfg.train.global_batch_size = 1536
+    cfg.train.micro_batch_size = 1
+
+    cfg.mixed_precision = bf16_with_mxfp8_mixed()
+    cfg.mixed_precision.grad_reduce_in_fp32 = False
+    cfg.ddp.grad_reduce_in_fp32 = False
+    cfg.model.recompute_granularity = None
+    cfg.model.recompute_modules = []
+    cfg.model.recompute_method = None
+    cfg.model.recompute_num_layers = None
+    cfg.model.cuda_graph_impl = "none"
+    cfg.model.cuda_graph_scope = None
+    cfg.model.cuda_graph_modules = []
+    cfg.rng.te_rng_tracker = True
+    cfg.model.use_te_rng_tracker = True
+    cfg.comm_overlap.tp_comm_overlap = True
+    cfg.comm_overlap.tp_comm_overlap_cfg = None
+
+    cfg.env_vars = {
+        **cfg.env_vars,
+        "CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS": 32,
+        "NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER": 0,
+        "PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+        "TORCH_NCCL_AVOID_RECORD_STREAMS": 1,
+        "NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE": 0,
+        "NCCL_P2P_NET_CHUNKSIZE": 2097152,
+        "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+    }
+    return cfg

+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers import LlamaConfig
+
+from megatron.bridge import AutoBridge
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.llama import llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.llama.h100.llama3 import llama31_405b_pretrain_256gpu_h100_bf16_config
+from megatron.bridge.training.config import runtime_config_update
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def offline_llama405b():
+    """Construct the real model configuration without downloading weights or metadata."""
+    hf_config = LlamaConfig(
+        architectures=["LlamaForCausalLM"],
+        num_hidden_layers=126,
+        hidden_size=16384,
+        intermediate_size=53248,
+        num_attention_heads=128,
+        num_key_value_heads=8,
+        vocab_size=128256,
+        max_position_embeddings=131072,
+        rms_norm_eps=1e-5,
+        rope_theta=500000.0,
+        tie_word_embeddings=False,
+        rope_scaling={
+            "factor": 8.0,
+            "low_freq_factor": 1.0,
+            "high_freq_factor": 4.0,
+            "original_max_position_embeddings": 8192,
+            "rope_type": "llama3",
+        },
+    )
+    with patch.object(
+        AutoBridge, "from_hf_pretrained", side_effect=lambda *a, **k: AutoBridge.from_hf_config(hf_config)
+    ):
+        yield
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+def test_llama405b_64gpu_runtime_contract(offline_llama405b, monkeypatch):
+    """Finalization must preserve the full model, precision, and measured execution settings."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("WORLD_SIZE", "64")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("RANK", "0")
+    cfg = llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()
+    runtime_config_update(cfg)
+    model = cfg.model
+    assert (model.num_layers, model.hidden_size, model.ffn_hidden_size) == (126, 16384, 53248)
+    assert (model.num_attention_heads, model.num_query_groups, model.vocab_size) == (128, 8, 128256)
+    assert (model.tensor_model_parallel_size, model.pipeline_model_parallel_size) == (8, 8)
+    assert (model.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size, model.context_parallel_size, cfg.data_parallel_size) == (
+        8,
+        1,
+        1,
+    )
+    assert (model.seq_length, cfg.dataset.seq_length) == (8192, 8192)
+    assert (cfg.train.global_batch_size, cfg.train.micro_batch_size) == (1536, 1)
+    assert model.sequence_parallel
+    assert model.account_for_embedding_in_pipeline_split and model.account_for_loss_in_pipeline_split
+    assert model.recompute_granularity is None
+    assert model.recompute_modules == []
+    assert model.recompute_method is None and model.recompute_num_layers is None
+    assert not model.cpu_offloading and not model.fine_grained_activation_offloading
+    assert not cfg.optimizer.optimizer_cpu_offload
+    assert model.fp8_recipe == "mxfp8" and model.fp8 == "e4m3" and model.fp8_param
+    assert not model.first_last_layers_bf16
+    assert cfg.ddp.fp8_param_gather
+    assert cfg.ddp.reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag
+    assert model.params_dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert model.cuda_graph_impl == "none" and model.cuda_graph_modules == []
+    assert not model.enable_cuda_graph and not model.external_cuda_graph
+    assert not cfg.optimizer.optimizer_cuda_graph
+    assert cfg.rng.te_rng_tracker and model.use_te_rng_tracker
+    assert not cfg.ddp.grad_reduce_in_fp32
+    assert model.tp_comm_overlap
+    assert cfg.comm_overlap.tp_comm_overlap_cfg is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+def test_llama405b_64gpu_retains_training_defaults(offline_llama405b):
+    """A capacity recipe must retain checkpointing, checks, and the training schedule."""
+    baseline = llama31_405b_pretrain_256gpu_h100_bf16_config()
+    cfg = llama31_405b_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()
+    assert cfg.train.train_iters == baseline.train.train_iters
+    assert cfg.scheduler == baseline.scheduler
+    assert cfg.checkpoint == baseline.checkpoint
+    assert cfg.validation == baseline.validation
+    assert cfg.optimizer == baseline.optimizer
+    assert cfg.ddp.check_for_nan_in_grad
+    assert cfg.rerun_state_machine.check_for_nan_in_loss
+    assert cfg.checkpoint.save is not None and cfg.checkpoint.load is not None
+    assert cfg.optimizer.main_params_dtype == torch.float32
+    assert cfg.optimizer.exp_avg_dtype == torch.float32
+    assert cfg.optimizer.exp_avg_sq_dtype == torch.float32
+    assert cfg.model.rope_scaling == baseline.model.rope_scaling
+    assert cfg.model.rope_scaling_factor == baseline.model.rope_scaling_factor
+    assert cfg.model.rotary_base == baseline.model.rotary_base
+    assert not cfg.tokenizer.use_tokenizer_vocab_size
